title: Ext comparison along an exact functor from a degree-zero generator
statement: Let U:A→B be an exact additive functor of abelian categories, A with enough injectives, and η:F→U(P). Let restrictionClass send x∈Ext^n_A(P,M) to η composed with U(x) in Ext^n_B(F,U(M)). If η∘U(-):Hom(P,M)→Hom(F,U(M)) is bijective for every M, and Ext^{n+1}_B(F,U(I)) vanishes for every injective I and every n, then restrictionClass is bijective in every degree n and for every M. The compatibility of restrictionClass with Yoneda composition is recorded alongside.

proof.text: Degree zero: Ext^0 is Hom by mk₀, and restrictionClass is the given bijection. Successor degree: embed M into an injective I with cokernel Q. The short exact sequence and its exact image under U give long exact Ext sequences; restrictionClass commutes with postcomposition by mk₀ and by the extension classes, by compatibility with composition and mapExactFunctor. Ext^{n+1}(P,I)=0 and Ext^{n+1}(F,U I)=0, so the cokernel form of the five lemma and induction give bijectivity.

lean.statement:
theorem restrictionClass_bijective [EnoughInjectives A]
    (hzero : ∀ M : A, Function.Bijective (fun f : P ⟶ M ↦ η ≫ U.map f))
    (hacyc : ∀ (I : A) [Injective I] (n : ℕ),
      Subsingleton (Ext.{wB} F (U.obj I) (n + 1)))
    (n : ℕ) (M : A) : Function.Bijective (restrictionClass U η M n)
